basis.quote: I got a small cut on the bottom of my foot about 4 days ago and now the skin around it is red and a little swollen
basis.interpretation: Four-day-old foot wound with active erythema and edema in a diabetic patient, raising concern for progressive cellulitis or early deep infection

basis.quote: It's tender when I press on it
basis.interpretation: Localized tenderness over the affected site consistent with soft-tissue inflammation or infection
Diabetes increases risk of severe infection, impaired healing, and rapid progression of foot infections including limb-threatening complications
Absence of reported fever does not exclude cellulitis, abscess, or systemic infection in a diabetic patient
